Package hadur2.core.duel

Class Duress

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.duel.Duress
public final class Duress extends Object
Duress (RES-9): what the core does with the rest of a round once the engine has skipped 3 of its turns in it. Every other computation level still runs the KNN gun and the surf, at halved k at best; a robot that cannot finish a tick in time dies when it stops moving, not when it aims badly. Duress runs nothing that grows or searches: no gun waves, no movement waves, no samples, no neighbour tree. It orbits the enemy at the distance floor (DistancePolicy.FLOOR), reversing at pseudo-random intervals so its path is not a straight line to predict, wall-smoothed so the reversal never drives it into a wall; fires head-on at power 1.0 whenever the gun is cool and on the enemy's last known spot; and keeps the radar on it.

The reversal's interval comes from a seeded generator (RES-6: no unseeded randomness), so a replay of the same inputs makes the same orders (CORE-2). A round in duress scores worse than a healthy one against a surfer and better than a dead robot against anything.
